---
title: "People"

listing:
  - id: current-members

      - "!index.qmd"
    type: grid
    include:
      status: "current"
    sort: "order asc"

      - image
      - title
      - role
      - interests

    sort-ui: false

  - id: alumni
    contents:
      - "*.qmd"
      - "!index.qmd"
    type: grid
    include:
      status: "alumni"
    sort: "order asc"
    fields:
      - title
      - current-position
    grid-columns: 2
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
---
